cheapest_next_experiment_that_could_chan.stage_1: Repair or replace the WAM action adapter on development-only data and require the overlay-masked residual causal gates to pass before any judge spend.
cheapest_next_experiment_that_could_chan.stage_2: Obtain a new independently labeled, disjoint DROID-compatible multi-policy rollout snapshot without Blueprint funding or operating physical robots.
cheapest_next_experiment_that_could_chan.stage_3: Freeze gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, the existing temporal and endpoint prompts, sampling, thresholds, and a hard stop before any new heldout call.
cheapest_next_experiment_that_could_chan.minimum_screening_design: Seven new independent sessions by seven candidate policies, both temporal and endpoint arms: 98 calls. This is a screening experiment, not the originally powered 49-session confirmation.
cheapest_next_experiment_that_could_chan.admission_rule: Do not execute until independent labels, action semantics, media rights, WAM generation cost, and total spend under the user cap are all attributable and frozen.

why_not_run_now: All 63 complete public OSCAR sessions are already allocated to pilot, calibration, or the frozen heldout partition.
The governing protocol forbids adding a new evaluator arm to the started holdout.
The released WAM adapter has not passed the necessary counterfactual action-conditioning gate.
A seven-session screen cannot by itself meet the original 49-cluster confirmation power.
claim_boundary: A bounded next-step design and token-identical API projection, not evidence that new data exist, that WAM generation fits the cap, or that GPT-5 mini ranks robot policies correctly.
